status: Planning estimates based on current 2026 services. Recheck when May / June 2027 timetables open.
assumptions: Trip starts at the Lake Nojiri cabin.
Public transit begins with a 10-20 minute taxi to Kurohime Station.
Hybrid travel uses taxi to Nagano Station, Limited Express Shinano to Matsumoto, then a prebooked taxi.
Private-road estimates assume a car is already at the cabin. Picking up a rental in Nagano adds roughly 60-90 minutes.
Ranges include ordinary connection time but not major traffic, missed connections, or meal stops.

publicTransit.route: Cabin taxi -> Kurohime -> Nagano -> Matsumoto -> Shin-Shimashima/Sawando -> Shirahone

railTaxi.route: Taxi to Nagano -> Limited Express Shinano to Matsumoto -> prebooked taxi to Shirahone

privateRoad.route: Direct rental car or full-distance prebooked taxi

publicTransit.route: Cabin taxi -> Kurohime -> Nagano -> Matsumoto -> direct bus to Hirayu

railTaxi.route: Taxi to Nagano -> Limited Express Shinano to Matsumoto -> prebooked taxi to Hirayu

privateRoad.route: Direct rental car or full-distance prebooked taxi

shirahone.tokyo: 4:45-5:30 via Matsumoto and Limited Express Azusa
shirahone.kyoto: 5:15-6:15 via Matsumoto, Nagoya, and Tokaido Shinkansen
shirahone.privateRoad: 4:30-5:45 to either city before traffic or stops

okuhida.tokyo: 4:45-5:30 by direct Hirayu-Shinjuku highway bus or via Matsumoto
okuhida.kyoto: 4:45-5:45 via Takayama/Nagoya rail; 5:15-6:15 by Takayama-Kyoto bus
okuhida.privateRoad: 4:30-5:30 to either city before traffic or stops
